text: ほそい　きは　いあいぎりで　きれるって　しってた？

structure.jp: いあいぎりで　きれるって
structure.en: that they can be cut with Cut

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: きる 'cut' changed to きれる means 'can cut' or 'can be cut'. きれる = 'can be cut'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual spoken form of と, and wraps up the thing that is known or said, like 'that'. きれるって　しってた = 'did you know that they can be cut'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that thing is the tool used to do the action. いあいぎりで = 'with Cut'.
